phase3_findings.description: The comment on _GENERIC_INPUT_PLACEHOLDERS lists the turn-end paths as 'normally or on its error and repeated-invalid-tool-call stop paths' but leaves out the tool-iteration-limit stop path (agent.py ~1128-1171, emits 'Continue the task or ask me something else...') and the starter-UI path (agent.py ~336, emits 'Ask a question...'). The set is complete; only the comment's path list is incomplete. Capped at Suggestion by the behavior-inert prose cap.

phase3_findings.description: The doc says without conditions that the agent's clarifying question renders as an ordinary text block; when an earlier run_sql lookup in the same turn fails and no later successful data run_sql follows, components_to_blocks' error short-circuit (_format.py ~491-495) returns isError: true and drops the question text. Not silent, but undocumented and untested. Capped at Suggestion by the behavior-inert prose cap.
